bypass_contract.applies_to: primary and bypass cards whose native contract fails a blocker
bypass_contract.strike_order: nearest |K-spot| first, OTM and ITM both allowed

notes.direction: every feature is side-aware: calls up/above, puts mirror down/below; SPY with/against relative to side
notes.rvol: RVOL is points only, not a gate (0.6-0.8 gets -9; <0.6 and >=1/1.5 got 0)
notes.fit: joint L2 logistic C=0.1, penalties x0.25, fit<2026-07-20 test>=2026-07-20
notes.v4c: adds Nia EMA terms as stacked interactions only; ~400 combinations tested by Nia -> shadow-check sized; live default profile moderate posts at 110. posting_threshold 60 is the research reference, not the live line.
notes.profiles: LOTTO_PROFILE selects aggressive (loose) 70/40/0/10, middle 77/40/0/10, balanced 84/40/0/10, or conservative (moderate, default) 92/40/0/10. post_threshold is not capped. Primary cards count features with value>=0.5. Bypass cards use bypass_threshold only. Bolt is score>=post_threshold and >=10 such features. No daily cap, top-N, or cooldown.

definitions.spy10: SPY 10AM pause/turn (f_spy10; ATR14 basis, cap 15, needs ATR21 re-cut)
definitions.spy_with: SPY move from open AND last 15m both in card direction
definitions.rvol_06_08: 0.6<=RVOL<0.8 (RVOL = cum vol / mean cum curve prior 10 full days)
definitions.room_hi: room used from open >1.0 ATR21 (calls high-open, puts open-low)
definitions.spy_vs: SPY move from open AND last 15m both against card
definitions.e1_ema9_2m_pullin_x_rvol15: Nia E1_ema9_2m (2-min 9 EMA pull-in) AND RVOL>=1.5, same side
definitions.requires_min_conf: count of {level break any age incl gap, RVOL>=1.5, SPY with trade, option vol5>=200} = Nia STOCK_NCONF
definitions.dip_reclaim: Nia loose def: trend = EMA rising vs 3 bars ago and close above EMA on >=60% of prior 8 bars; dip = low 0.05-0.5 ATR21 beyond EMA; reclaim = close back across EMA (and beyond prior close) within 1-4 bars; fresh 10/15/20 min on 2/5/10-min; causal (bars through m-1); puts mirror

score_rule: score = sum over features of weight[side] x value (value 0/1 or 0-1 fit); post if score >= posting_threshold and no blocker fails on the chosen contract

lotto_env.LOTTO_STRONG_SCORE: n/a - bolt is score>=20 AND >=10 positive features (no score-only cut reaches 50%)
lotto_env.LOTTO_FB_ROOM_ATR_MAX: none as gate; use bypass_weights room +30
lotto_env.LOTTO_FB_MIN_MINUTES: 0 as gate; m>=15 is -5 in bypass_penalties
lotto_env.units: LOTTO_BLOCKER_SPREAD is a fraction (0.15); LOTTO_FB_MAX_SPREAD_PCT is a percent (15)
